title: FloodReasonBench: Benchmarking VLM Reasoning Segmentation for Embodied Flood Response at the Edge
abstract: arXiv:2608.15410v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning segmentation enables vision-language models (VLMs) to translate mission-relevant language requests into pixel-level visual grounding, offering a natural perception interface for embodied agents. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on generic visual scenes and overlook the domain and resource constraints encountered in flood-response platforms. We present FloodReasonBench, a benchmark for VLM reasoning segmentation for embodied flood response at the edge. At its core, FloodReasonBench introduces FloodResponseSeg, a flood-specific reasoning-segmentation dataset constructed from real-world scenes and response-relevant targets. Beyond task accuracy, the benchmark characterizes reasoning-segmentation pipelines under lightweight visual encoding, hierarchical split inference, and compressed intermediate representations. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15410v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：推理分割使视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够将任务相关的语言请求转换为像素级视觉定位，为具身代理提供了自然的感知接口。然而，现有基准大多聚焦于通用视觉场景，忽略了洪水响应平台中遇到的领域和资源限制。我们提出了FloodReasonBench，一个面向边缘具身洪水响应的VLM推理分割基准。其核心是引入了FloodResponseSeg，一个基于真实场景和响应相关目标构建的洪水特定推理分割数据集。除了任务准确性外，该基准还表征了在轻量级视觉编码、分层拆分推理和压缩中间表示下的推理分割流程。我们观察到在通用预适应设置中存在显著的基于分区的准确性变化，而进一步的分析表明……
tldr: 该论文提出了FloodReasonBench，一个专为边缘具身洪水响应设计的推理分割基准，引入洪水特定数据集FloodResponseSeg，并系统评估了轻量级编码和分层推理下的性能变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FloodReasonBench, a benchmark for VLM reasoning segmentation in embodied flood response at the edge, featuring the flood-specific dataset FloodResponseSeg and evaluating performance under lightweight encoding and hierarchical inference.
